home.amuni_text: Amunì is not just an invitation to travel, it's the embrace of our land. It means 'let's do it together': don't just watch from afar, but enter into the heartbeat of the village. When we say Amunì, we are erasing the border between those who arrive and those who stay, to turn every step into a shared discovery.
home.castellana_intro_text: Speak with the Castellana: your multilingual tour guide to discover stories, hidden gems, and gourmet paths among the wonders of the village and the surrounding area.

castle.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castle.rhyme_1:
Welcome, oh travelers, to the mighty manor,
that scans the valley and the present history.
Perched on the mountain of proud living stone,
guardian of dreams, of glory, and mystery.
castle.rhyme_2:
Within these walls that defy time,
dynasties passed like a breath in the wind.
From the proud adventurous Chiaramonte,
every room tells of pacts and splendor.
castle.rhyme_3:
Do not look for dates in a cold volume,
but the shadow that dances at the setting of the candle.
The Castellana awaits you, among the steps and the path,
to reveal to you the secret of Sister Felicia.
castle.welcomemsg_felicia: Welcome to the Castle of Caccamo, stranger. I am Sister Felicia. Do you want me to reveal the secrets of the Conspiracy Room or would you prefer to listen to the ancient legends of the manor? Ask me anything.
castle.position: A fortress perched on a rocky spur, with a dominant view over the valley.
castle.defense: Loopholes, thick walls, and patrol walkways tell of its defensive function.
castle.conspiracy: Secret rooms and noble chambers were the stage for medieval conspiracies and intrigues.
castle.prisons: The underground prisons still guard the traces of ancient detentions.
castle.legend_brothers: The legend of the two brothers tells of a fatal duel for the love of a lady.

castello.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castello.description: The Castle of Caccamo is among the largest and best-preserved Norman fortresses in Sicily. Perched on the living rock since the 11th century, it dominates the San Leonardo valley with its imposing walls, watchtowers, and suggestive internal halls that evoke centuries of feudal history and chivalric legends.
castello.tickets: Full price € 6.00 | Reduced € 4.50 (Exclusively with online booking)

badia.title: Church of San Benedetto alla Badia
badia.description: A true jewel of Sicilian Baroque, the church is famous worldwide for its extraordinary floor entirely made of 18th-century majolica, depicting allegorical scenes and naturalistic motifs of rare mastery. A masterpiece of visual art suspended in time.
badia.hours: Tue - Sun: 09:00 – 12:30 | Mon: 14:30 – 18:30 (No regular functions, ideal for visits)
badia.tickets: Full price € 2.00 | Reduced € 1.00 (EU youth 18-25 or with Castle ticket same day) | Free under 18

santamaria.title: Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli
santamaria.description: Founded in the 15th century together with the Dominican convent, the Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli is one of the most important spiritual centers of the village. It guards the remains and relics of Blessed Giovanni Liccio, Patron Saint of Caccamo. Inside, you can admire splendid marble altars and sacred artworks that testify to centuries of deep devotion and pilgrimages.
santamaria.hours: Opening and Visits: Saturday from 16:00 to 17:30 | Sunday from 09:00 to 10:00 and from 11:00 to 12:30. (Holy Masses: Saturday at 17:30 | Sunday at 10:00).

sangiorgio.title: Church of San Giorgio Martire
sangiorgio.description: The Mother Church of Caccamo, dedicated to Saint George the Martyr, is an imposing masterpiece that dominates the monumental square below the Castle. Founded in the Norman era and rebuilt in 1614, it preserves an immense artistic heritage: from sculptures of the Gagini school to precious 17th-century canvases by the Flemish painter Matthias Stom, up to the rich chapels decorated in mixed marbles.
sangiorgio.hours: Visit hours: Saturday and Sunday 09:30 – 10:45 and 16:00 – 18:00. (Tourist reception is suspended during the Sunday Holy Mass at 11:00).

annunziata.title: Parish of the SS. Annunziata
annunziata.description: Nestled in the medieval urban fabric, the church stands out for its facade and the atmosphere of deep spirituality that is breathed inside. It preserves finely decorated altars and artistic artifacts that attract visitors and the faithful.
annunziata.hours: Mon - Sat: 09:00 – 12:00 | Weekday masses at 18:00. Sunday and holidays visits in slots: 08:30 - 09:30 and 10:30 - 12:00 (Holiday masses at 09:30, 12:00, 19:00).

cappuccini.title: Convent of the Capuchin Friars
cappuccini.description: A place of silence, meditation, and history, the structures of the Convent are deeply linked to the Franciscan tradition in Sicily. In addition to the convent structure, the area offers an authentic glimpse of monastic life and popular devotion.
cappuccini.hours: Accessible mainly upon request or during Franciscan recurrences. Contact the Tourism Office.
cappuccini.secret_info: 💡 The Hidden Jewels of Caccamo: The village is home to 33 churches. Use the Din Don Dan map and zoom in on Caccamo to discover the hours and real-time openings of lesser-known treasures such as the Church of San Rocco and other small scattered masterpieces.

chiese_page.poesia_intro:
Five stone temples, of faith and memory,
open their doors to a centuries-old history.
chiese_page.verse_angeli:
At the Angels rests, in the most sacred silence,
Blessed Giovanni, the village's icon.
chiese_page.verse_badia:
If you descend to the Badia, the earth becomes a flower
in the majolica embroidery of rare splendor.
chiese_page.verse_duomo:
Enter the great Duomo, majestic and solemn,
among the Gagini marbles and the perennial Stomer.
chiese_page.verse_annunziata:
Then the Annunziata unveils its painted vaults,
and the bell tower never conquered by guards.
chiese_page.verse_cappuccini:
Finally climb to the Capuchins, on the radiant hill,
among an altarpiece and a majestic panorama.
chiese_page.poesia_outro: Let yourself be guided where time has stopped...

transport_page.welcome: Welcome, oh traveler, to the Transport section. Here you will find the necessary information to move around the surroundings of the village.
transport_page.company_desc: The bus lines connect Caccamo to Termini Imerese and Palermo all year round. By taking the afternoon run to Palermo, it is possible to get off at Vetrana, a renowned seaside area. From Termini Imerese, you can also take the train to Cefalù and other tourist destinations.
transport_page.stop_1: Porta Euracea: in front of Bar Giallombardo and the building materials store.
transport_page.stop_2: Viale Regione Siciliana: above the 'Roberta' playground (near the Axa insurance agency).
transport_page.stop_3: Piazza Cappuccini: in the shade of the ancient Convent.

events_page.title: Rites and Festivals of the Village
events_page.intro: Experience the most authentic soul of our village through its centuries-old traditions, where faith, history, and folklore intertwine in unique and exciting moments.
events_page.signuruzzu_desc: On Palm Sunday, a local child impersonates Jesus and rides on a decorated donkey through the village streets decorated for the occasion with palms. The procession stops in front of the Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli and the Duomo of San Giorgio Martire for the evocative blessing.
events_page.venerdi_desc: The atmosphere becomes profound with altars set up in the churches for Good Friday, enriched with the typical dishes of wheat sprouted in the dark. This is followed by the solemn and moving Procession and the town's Via Crucis.
events_page.giovanni_desc: A commemoration deeply felt and lived by the entire community, which gathers around its Blessed one in a climate of great devotion and popular warmth.
events_page.castellana_title: Election of the Castellana & Historical Procession
events_page.castellana_desc: The village dives back into its glorious medieval past. A majestic historical procession in period costumes crosses the streets, culminating in the solemn election of the Castellana of the manor.
events_page.nicasio_title: Feast of Saint Nicasio and the Palio
events_page.nicasio_desc: Vibrant celebrations in honor of the Saint, enriched by the highly anticipated and gripping town Palio that ignites the challenge and enthusiasm of young and old.
events_page.sagra_desc: Every year, on October 12th, the scents of tradition invade the village. An unmissable gastronomic appointment to taste authentic local sausage among songs, wine, and conviviality.
